summary: Temporary restricted area from ground level to 4,000 feet above sea level between Cambridge and EGR219, applying to all aircraft including drones.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED (CAMBRIDGE TO EGR219) AREA 
C. WI AREA BOUNDED BY: 525216.00N 0002601.00E - 
525034.00N 0003308.00E - 521358.32N 0000728.89E THEN ANTI-CLOCKWISE 
ARC OF A CIRCLE RADIUS 2.5 NM CENTRED 521218.00N 0001030.00E TO 
521228.21N 0000626.75E - 521105.00N 0000528.00E - 
521105.00N 0000330.00W - 525216.00N 0002601.00E.
APPLIES TO ALL ACFT INCLUDING ANY SMALL BALLOON, ANY KITE, ANY UAS 
AND ANY PARACHUTE INCLUDING A PARASCENDING PARACHUTE OR PARAMOTOR. 
DOES NOT APPLY TO ANY ACFT FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS 
STATED IN THE BRIEFING SHEET. A BRIEFING SHEET BFS 141/2026 WITH 
CHARTS, REFERS. FURTHER DETAILS WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. RESTRICTION OF 
FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAV ORDER 2016. 
AR-2026-10578/03.
